result.label: bug
result.what_to_change: In parseStatement, only one trailing empty string (from the final newline) is popped from `lines`; a statement that ends with an actual blank line leaves one empty line in the array, which splitFields turns into a single-field row that fails assertShape with errors.rowShape. The loop (or the trailing-line trim) should skip/ignore blank lines at the end of the file (or any blank line) instead of assuming at most one trailing empty string.
result.evidence: parser.ts does `if (lines.length > 0 && lines[lines.length - 1] === "") lines.pop();` which removes only the single empty string produced by the file's final newline; a file with an extra blank line after the last transaction leaves a remaining empty-string line that gets parsed as a row with one empty field, triggering `throw new IngestError("errors.rowShape", { row: index + 1 })` at the row just past the last transaction, matching the reported behavior.

not_searched: other parsers/importers for other file formats (e.g. OFX/QIF) that might share this logic

The loop (or the trailing-line trim) should skip/ignore blank lines at the end of the file (or any blank line) instead of assuming at most one trailing empty string.
